title: Mass cytometry immunostaining protocol for multiplexing clinical samples
protocol: Collect sample vials in a separate box for quick retrieval on the day of staining.
Keep samples in liquid nitrogen storage until ready to begin the protocol.
Fill pre-labeled 15 mL tubes with 5 mL of pre-warmed thawing media prepared as described below.
Incubate thawing media in a 37°C water bath.
Prepare a 2× master mix in CSM for surface staining.
Determine the amount of diluent (CSM) needed based on the total volume of antibodies to be added.
Place antibody vials and Eppendorf tube on ice.
Arrange antibody vials in the order listed.
Add the first antibody to the Eppendorf tube to achieve the desired concentration.
Continue adding subsequent antibodies to the mix, ensuring accuracy for each addition.
Prepare an extra 25 μL of master mix to account for pipetting errors.
Transfer used antibody vial to another ice bucket and check it off from the list.
Repeat steps until all surface antibodies have been added.
Store master mix 1 at 4°C and vortex before use.
Prepare a 1× mix in 1× permeabilization buffer according to optimal dilutions for each intracellular antibody.
Add antibodies as previously described.
Store master mix 2 at 4°C and vortex before use.
Dilute 10× Maxpar barcode buffer using Maxpar PBS to prepare 1× Maxpar perm barcode buffer.
Add fixation/permeabilization concentrate from eBioscience FOXP3/transcription factor staining buffer kit to the fixation/permeabilization diluent at a ratio of 1:3.
Add 50 μL of Fc receptor binding inhibitor to 450 μL CSM to prepare Fc blocker.
Add 8 μL Cell-ID™ intercalator – 103Rh to 4 mL of RPMI to prepare viability buffer.
Add 1 ml of 10× Permeabilization Buffer from eBioscience FOXP3/transcription Factor Staining Buffer Kit to 9 ml of ddH2O to prepare permeabilization buffer.
Prepare DNA staining buffer by adding 1 μL Cell-ID™ intercalator-Ir (125 μM) to 1 mL of Maxpar fix and perm buffer.
Add each antibody master mix into a separate 0.1 μm Millipore centrifuge tube.
Spin the centrifuge tubes with a fixed-angle rotor at 12,000 × g for 2 min at 4°C.
Discard the Millipore filter and store the tubes at 4°C.
Thaw samples one at a time by placing vial on a rack in a 37°C water bath for approximately 1 minute.
Transfer the contents of the freshly thawed vial into a pre-labeled tube containing 5 mL thawing media on ice.
Centrifuge the sample tubes at 600 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged samples.
Count each sample manually using a hemocytometer and record the viable cell counts if not previously done.
Resuspend cell pellets in 100 μL thawing media.
Transfer the resuspended cells to a 96-well V-bottom plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 600 × g, 4°C for 3 minutes.
Discard the supernatant from the centrifuged plate.
Add 40 μL of CD45-194Pt to one 103Rh-viability buffer tube.
Add 40 μL of CD45-198Pt to the other 103Rh-viability buffer tube.
Using a multichannel pipette, add 100 μL of the CD45-194Pt-103Rh-RPMI mix to the first 20 wells of the 96-well V-bottom plate and mix by gentle pipetting.
Using a multichannel pipette, add 100 μL of the CD45-198Pt-103Rh-RPMI mix to the remaining 20 wells of the 96-well V-bottom plate and mix by gentle pipetting.
Incubate the plate for 15 min at 37°C.
Add 100 μL of PBS to each well.
Centrifuge at 600 × g, 4°C for 3 min.
Flick the plate to discard the supernatant.
Blot the plate gently on a paper towel to remove any residual supernatant.
Add 5 mL of fixation/permeabilization buffer to a multichannel pipette solution basin.
Using a multichannel pipette, add 100 μL of fixation/permeabilization buffer to each well and resuspend cells by gentle pipetting.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Place the 4 mini-vial strips in rack as shown.
Let them thaw at room temperature.
Add 100 μL of 1× Maxpar perm barcode buffer to each well of the plate containing the sample using multichannel pipette and solution basin.
Centrifuge the plate at 900 × g, 4°C for 3 min.
Flick the plate to discard the supernatant.
Blot the plate gently on paper towel to get rid of any residual supernatant.
Add 100 μL of 1× Maxpar barcode buffer to each barcode mini-vial, and mix well by gentle pipetting.
Transfer 100 μL from each barcode vial to its respective sample well in the 96-well V-bottom plate according to the barcode map.
Mix well by gentle pipetting.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Add 100 μL of Maxpar CSM to each well.
Centrifuge at 900 × g, 4°C for 3 min.
Flick the plate to discard the supernatant.
Blot the plate gently on paper towel to get rid of any residual supernatant.
Add 200 μL of Maxpar CSM to each well.
Repeat steps to wash cells twice to ensure no leftover barcodes remain in any wells and prevent mixing of barcodes when samples are pooled.
Pool samples by transferring the content of each well to a 4 mL polystyrene conical “FACS” tube.
Centrifuge at 900 × g, 4°C for 5 min.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend up to 80 × 10^6 cells in 150 μL of Fc blocker.
Mix by gentle pipetting.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Add 150 μL of 2× surface stain (master mix 1) directly to the sample.
Mix by gentle pipetting.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Add 2 mL of CSM to each well and mix by gentle pipetting.
Centrifuge at 900 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Add 2 mL of 1× permeabilization buffer and resuspend the cell pellet by gentle pipetting.
Centrifuge at 900 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Add 300 μL of 1× intracellular stain (master mix 2).
Mix by pipetting up and down three times.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Add 2 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge at 900 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Suspend the cell pellet in 300 μL of DNA staining buffer.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Add 2 mL PBS.
Centrifuge at 900 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Suspend stained cells in 200 μL of 1.6% FA/PBS for storage up to one week at 4°C.
Add 2 mL of PBS to the stained and barcoded cells on the day of acquisition.
Centrifuge at 900 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 1 mL PBS.
Count cells manually using a hemocytometer and record the cell count.
Filter the cells using the 5 mL Round Bottom Polystyrene Test Tube with Cell Strainer Snap Cap.
Centrifuge at 900 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant and keep the tube containing the cell pellet on ice.
